newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, falling from early highs as buying by private investors ebbed late in the day.
Newly listed benchmark September closed at 150.8 yen after opening at 153.0 yen. Other prices ranged from 1.1 yen to 2.1 yen per kg lower.

The market started the day on a firmer tone, supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar. "But buying lost steam later, as the weak spot expiry price on Tuesday continued to dampen market sentiment," one analyst at a commodity broker said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk, +81-3-3432-7431
